echo 'conservatory-admin-key.json' >> .gitignore

git rm --cached .env
git commit -m 'security: stop tracking .env'

# Verify .gitignore is working
git status  # .env should appear as 'untracked', not 'modified'

# Create .env.example with placeholder values
echo 'VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=your-firebase-api-key' >> .env.example

git add .env.example && git commit -m 'chore: add .env.example template'
